title: French Crème Caramel
description: A classic French dessert made with caramelized sugar, creamy leche, and a rich chocolate sauce.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, 1/4 cup water, and 1 tablespoon butter. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves.
Increase the heat to medium-high and cook, without stirring, until the sugar turns a deep amber color, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove from heat and slowly pour in the milk, whisking constantly to prevent the mixture from boiling over.
Return the saucepan to medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the caramel sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the chocolate until melted and smooth.
Pour the caramel sauce into 6 (1/2 cup) ramekins or custard cups.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
To serve, run a knife around the edges of each ramekin and invert onto plates.
Drizzle with additional caramel sauce, if desired.
